A_foundation.goal: Boot runtime, UI, router, agents, memory; confirm health; mobile-first UI contract.

B_image_to_fulljson.goal: Blueprint image → truth boxes → structure tree → layout hints → full.json render plan (deterministic).

D_verify.goal: Truth layout verify + pixel diff heatmap + gate decisions.

systemInstruction.coreDirective: You are the ARTYVERSE X Design Operating System. You orchestrate prompt -> design -> code -> verify -> export, and you also run the ARTYVERSE X AI Assistant for live Thai Q&A. Respect token locks, the pixel-space contract, the rename alias map and the honesty rules (never invent numbers, clients or experience).
capabilities: Parse natural language design prompts into structured UI specs
Generate full HTML/CSS/JS from a single prompt
Apply design styles (editorial, luxury, fashion, neon, minimal, modular) on-the-fly
Auto-layout, auto-responsive, auto-polish, auto-wording refinement
Generate component trees with Tailwind v4 class mapping
Run verification gates (layout truth, beauty render, contrast check)
Export to HTML, Next.js, and asset bundles
Self-learn from user feedback and usage patterns
Run the ARTYVERSE X AI Assistant pipeline (intake, retrieve, compose, model, validate, lint, render)
Enforce security, privacy and accessibility gates before any export
Maintain a single token source of truth across portfolio, component library, WhisperX Studio and assistant

oneClickDesign.description: Given a prompt or image, automatically generate a complete design system UI with all tokens, components, and layout applied.
steps: Parse input prompt or image → extract intent
Apply design tokens (color, typography, spacing, radius, shadow)
Generate components with Tailwind v4 classes
Return full JSON spec and HTML preview

oneClickRefine.description: Given an existing UI spec, refine and polish it with one click.
steps: Analyze for improvement opportunities (spacing, contrast, motion, wording)

autoLayout.description: Automatically apply optimal layout rules based on content type and device.
rules: Use flex for 1D layouts, grid for 2D layouts
Use container queries for component-level responsiveness
Apply logical properties for RTL support

autoResponsive.description: Automatically generate responsive variants for all breakpoints.
rules: Mobile-first: base styles first, then sm: md: lg: xl: 2xl:
Apply container queries (@sm: @md: @lg:) for component-level responsiveness

autoPolish.description: Apply visual polish to any UI spec.
rules: Ensure contrast ratios meet WCAG AA

autoWording.description: Automatically refine titles, labels, values, and copy in the UI.
rules: Title case for headings, sentence case for labels
Replace placeholder text with meaningful values
Ensure consistent terminology across the UI

{
  "id": "global-tw4-master.json",
  "version": "everything x data",
  "meta": {
    "description": "Single-file master dataset for Tailwind v4 mapping, class AST, UI nodes/elements, interactions, motion, spatial/3D, agents, workflows A–E, verification gates, and self-learning memory. Built to support image→UI and prompt→UI pipelines. | V3 adds IntelliHint ghost autocomplete, expanded short/combos/snippets, framework detection, safety gates, and export policies for WhisperX Code Intelligence Engine. | FULL pack expands suggestionRegistry with large short/combos/prefixIndex, adds snippets, intent library, component type priors, and validation rules. | FULL-MAX expands to 1000+ shorts, 250+ combos, 120+ prefixes, adds taxonomy, intent packs, and strict validation for IntelliHint. | ALL_IN_ONE merged: ANTIGRAVITY_ALWAYS_ON_ALL_TO_END + ALL_IN_APPEND_END + base/v2 snapshots for backward coverage.",
    "createdAt": "2026-02-20T23:19:45.005582Z",
    "target": [
      "web-ide",
      "browser-os",
      "mobile-first",
      "agent-platform",
      "image-to-ui",
      "prompt-to-ui"
    ],
    "standards": [
      "html5",
      "es2024",
      "wcag-2.2",
      "tailwind-v4"
    ],
    "locks": {
      "pixelSpace": "1:1",
      "noNormalizeByDefault": true,
      "noSemanticOverride": true,
      "deterministic": true
    },
    "updatedAt": "2026-02-21T08:52:55Z",
    "lastUpdated": "2026-02-21T08:52:55Z",
  },
  "tailwindV4Core": {
    "config": {
      "major": 4,
      "mode": "jit-edge",
      "mobileFirst": true,
      "features": [
        "containerQueries",
        "logicalProperties",
        "colorMix",
        "viewTransitions",
        "oklchColorSpace",
        "fluidTypography",
        "arbitraryProperties",
        "arbitraryVariants"
      ]
    },
    "breakpoints": {
      "viewport": [
        "base",
        "sm",
        "md",
        "lg",
        "xl",
        "2xl"
      ],
      "container": [
        "@sm",
        "@md",
        "@lg",
        "@xl",
        "@2xl",
        "@3xl",
        "@4xl"
      ],
      "valuesPx": {
        "sm": 640,
        "md": 768,
        "lg": 1024,
        "xl": 1280,
        "2xl": 1536
      },
      "policy": {
        "default": "base",
        "useResponsiveOnlyIfEvidence": true,
        "normalizeAcrossBreakpoints": false
      }
    },
    "layoutSafety": {
      "requiredAlways": [
        "box-border",
        "min-w-0",
        "min-h-0"
      ],
      "recommended": [
        "antialiased"
      ],
      "avoidDefault": [
        "border (size-affecting)",
        "hover:scale-* (jitter)"
      ],
      "safeAlternatives": {
        "border": [
          "ring-1 ring-black/10",
          "shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_rgba(0,0,0,0.10)]"
        ],
        "hoverScale": [
          "hover:brightness-[0.98]",
          "hover:shadow-md"
        ]
      }
    },
    "thresholds": {
      "normalize": {
        "absPx": 2,
        "ratio": 0.08,
        "radiusPx": 2,
        "fontPx": 2,
        "lineHeightPx": 2
      },
      "layout": {
        "maxDriftPx": {
          "mobile": 2,
          "desktop": 3
        },
        "minIoU": 0.995
      }
    }
  },
  "workflows_A_to_E": {
    "A_foundation": {
      "goal": "Boot runtime, UI, router, agents, memory; confirm health; mobile-first UI contract.",
      "gates": [
        "env_ok",
        "ui_ok",
        "router_ok",
        "agents_ready"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "healthReport",
        "runtimeConfig",
        "uiContractSnapshot"
      ]
    },
    "B_image_to_fulljson": {
      "goal": "Blueprint image → truth boxes → structure tree → layout hints → full.json render plan (deterministic).",
      "gates": [
        "blueprint_locked",
        "id_consistent",
        "runtime_validator_ok"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "fullJson.match.truth",
        "fullJson.match.structure",
        "fullJson.match.layoutHints"
      ]
    },
    "C_beauty_and_mapping": {
      "goal": "Design tokens + nodeStyles + TW4 mapping dataset + suggestion registry (ghost/hint/snippet).",
      "gates": [
        "tokens_ready",
        "nodeStyles_covered"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "fullJson.beauty",
        "mappingPack",
        "suggestionRegistry"
      ]
    },
    "D_verify": {
      "goal": "Truth layout verify + pixel diff heatmap + gate decisions.",
      "gates": [
        "truthLayout_pass",
        "beautyRender_pass"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "verify.truthLayout",
        "verify.beautyRender",
        "exportGate"
      ]
    },
    "E_export": {
      "goal": "Export HTML + Next.js Tailwind v4 + component tree + className map; block if gates fail.",
      "gates": [
        "exportGate.match",
        "exportGate.verify"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "export.html",
        "export.nextjs",
        "export.assets",
        "export.reports"
      ]
    }
  },
  "classnameASTEngine": {
    "anatomy": [
      "themeModifier",
      "relationModifier",
      "breakpointModifier",
      "coreUtility",
      "value",
      "opacityModifier"
    ],
    "modifiers": {
      "responsive": [
        "sm:",
        "md:",
        "lg:",
        "xl:",
        "2xl:",
        "min-[320px]:",
        "max-[480px]:"
      ],
      "container": [
        "@sm:",
        "@md:",
        "@lg:",
        "@[17.5rem]:"
      ],
      "theme": [
        "dark:",
        "light:",
        "motion-reduce:",
        "rtl:",
        "ltr:"
      ],
      "pseudo": [
        "hover:",
        "focus-visible:",
        "active:",
        "disabled:",
        "invalid:",
        "first:",
        "last:"
      ],
      "relational": [
        "group-hover:",
        "peer-checked:",
        "has-[:checked]:",
        "group-has-[:hover]:"
      ],
      "a11y": [
        "aria-checked:",
        "aria-expanded:",
        "aria-[sort=ascending]:",
        "data-[state=open]:"
      ]
    },
    "arbitraryVariants": [
      "[&>p]:mt-4",
      "[&+div]:hidden",
      "[@supports(display:grid)]:grid"
    ],
    "conflictResolution": {
      "engine": "tailwind-merge-core",
      "rules": [
        "Later utility overwrites former within same group.",
        "State variants do not erase base; they overlay at runtime.",
        "Arbitrary variants have highest specificity within their selector scope."
      ]
    },
    "bindings": {
      "react": "twMerge(clsx(base, condition && active, dynamic))",
      "cva": "cva(base, { variants, defaultVariants })"
    },
    "valueDotSyntax": {
      "enabled": true,
      "separator": ".",
      "appendToEnd": true,
      "absolutePx": true,
      "supported": {
        "w": {
          "emit": "w-[{n}px]"
        },
        "h": {
          "emit": "h-[{n}px]"
        },
        "responsive": {
          "sm": true,
          "md": true,
          "lg": true,
          "xl": true,
          "2xl": true
        }
      },
      "tokenForms": [
        "w{n}",
        "h{n}",
        "{bp}w{n}",
        "{bp}h{n}"
      ]
    }
  },

goals: Chat-first assistant (Whisper) that can create real files via Agent
Local-first offline mode with online fallback
Image → UI Pro pipeline using global mapping JSON
Production deploy mode (build, test, package, release)
nonGoals: Unsafe autonomous actions outside explicit user commands

coreApp.name: WhisperX IDE
capabilities: upload
download
save/open
zip-export
hot-reload
git-commit

agentWorker.name: Whisper Agent Hand
agentWorker.role: Transforms chat outputs into real files and zips them on demand
limits: never deletes user files without explicit permission

systemInstruction.coreDirective: You are the WPX Design Operating System. You orchestrate the entire product creation lifecycle from prompt → design → code → verify → export. You operate with full deterministic precision, respecting all token locks, pixel-space contracts, and append-only policies.
capabilities: Parse natural language design prompts into structured UI specs
Generate full HTML/CSS/JS from a single prompt
Apply design styles (editorial, luxury, fashion, neon, minimal, modular) on-the-fly
Auto-layout, auto-responsive, auto-polish, auto-wording refinement
Generate component trees with Tailwind v4 class mapping
Run verification gates (layout truth, beauty render, contrast check)
Export to HTML, Next.js, and asset bundles
Self-learn from user feedback and usage patterns

oneClickDesign.description: Given a prompt or image, automatically generate a complete design system UI with all tokens, components, and layout applied.
steps: Parse input prompt or image → extract intent
Apply design tokens (color, typography, spacing, radius, shadow)
Generate components with Tailwind v4 classes
Return full JSON spec and HTML preview

oneClickRefine.description: Given an existing UI spec, refine and polish it with one click.
steps: Analyze for improvement opportunities (spacing, contrast, motion, wording)

autoLayout.description: Automatically apply optimal layout rules based on content type and device.
rules: Use flex for 1D layouts, grid for 2D layouts
Use container queries for component-level responsiveness
Apply logical properties for RTL support

autoResponsive.description: Automatically generate responsive variants for all breakpoints.
rules: Mobile-first: base styles first, then sm: md: lg: xl: 2xl:
Apply container queries (@sm: @md: @lg:) for component-level responsiveness

autoPolish.description: Apply visual polish to any UI spec.
rules: Ensure contrast ratios meet WCAG AA

autoWording.description: Automatically refine titles, labels, values, and copy in the UI.
rules: Title case for headings, sentence case for labels
Replace placeholder text with meaningful values
Ensure consistent terminology across the UI

valueConstraints.meta.target: must include at least one target
valueConstraints.meta.standards: must include at least one standard
